title: Contact
description: Contact Tokenization 2050 — editorial enquiries, corrections, tips, and press releases.
body:
# Contact

We welcome enquiries from readers, industry professionals, regulators, and media.

## Editorial

For news tips, press releases, story ideas, or editorial enquiries:

**Email**: editorial@tokenization2050.com

## Corrections

To report an error in our coverage:

**Email**: corrections@tokenization2050.com

Please include the article URL, the specific error, and supporting evidence. We review all correction requests and respond within 48 hours. See our [Corrections policy](/corrections/).

## General Enquiries

For partnerships, advertising enquiries, or general questions:

**Email**: info@tokenization2050.com

## Social Media

Follow Tokenization 2050 for updates:

- **X (Twitter)**: @tokenization2050
- **LinkedIn**: Tokenization 2050
- **Telegram**: @tokenization2050

## Response Times

We aim to respond to all enquiries within two business days.
